blocks.text: ILOILO CITY, Philippines — Rivers and tributaries across Western Visayas could be affected by rains and thunderstorms brought by the intertropical convergence zone (ITCZ), prompting state weather forecasters to warn residents in low-lying areas and near mountain slopes to take precautions. In General Flood Advisory No. 1 for Western Visayas issued at 6 p.m. Wednesday, Sept. 16, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the ITCZ was affecting Southern Luzon, the Visayas and Mindanao.
